enable_firewalld.description: Enable firewalld as the main firewall service. Disable only if using an alternative firewall like nftables.

runtime_directory.description: Path to directory for runtime state files (e.g., socket, PID, zone state).

config_directory.description: Path to persistent configuration directory (zones, services, ipsets).

firewall_backend.description: Absolute path to the firewalld executable. Rarely changed.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of tracked connections. Increase on high-traffic systems to avoid conntrack table exhaustion.

log_denied.description: Log packets that are dropped or rejected. Valid values: 'off', 'unicast', 'broadcast', 'all'.

logging.description: Enable or disable all logging of firewall events.

log_level.description: Minimum log level for firewall events (e.g., 'warning', 'error', 'debug'). Lower = more verbose.

allow_rfc3964.description: Enable RFC3964-compliant IPv6 address filtering (e.g., for 6to4 tunnels). Disable only if legacy IPv6 tunnel issues occur.

enable_ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 firewalling. Disable only if the system uses IPv6-only (but note: firewalld requires IPv6 support even for IPv4-only setups).

enable_ipv4.description: Enable IPv4 firewalling. Disable only if the system is IPv6-only.

trusted_interfaces.description: List of network interfaces that should bypass all firewall rules (fully trusted).

default_zone.description: Zone applied to new or unassigned interfaces. Must match a zone filename (e.g., 'public.xml') in /etc/firewalld/zones/.

automatic_zone_assignment.description: If enabled, new interfaces are automatically assigned to DefaultZone on activation.
